create.name: Nina Rao
create.bio:
Nina Rao is a kirtan leader and chant artist based in New York whose practice comes from the devotional, or bhakti, traditions of India. She first learned bhajans as a nine-year-old from her grandfather in a south Indian village, returned to chanting through Krishna Das in New York in 1996, and has worked beside him ever since as business manager, accompanist on cymbals and voice, and fellow chant leader. From 1998 she spent nineteen years visiting her guru, Sri Siddhi Ma, in the Himalayan foothills, and she has more recently studied Vedic recitation with a teacher from the Mysore lineage.

Nina treats chanting as a daily practice rather than a performance: call-and-response kirtan, japa, prayers to the Goddess and the Hanuman Chalisa, with care for pronunciation and meaning. She leads kirtans, workshops and retreats in New York, around the United States and in India, often alongside Krishna Das, and every New Year's Day hosts a day of 108 Hanuman Chalisas at Tibet House. She has released three solo albums, Antarayaami, Anubhav and Bhumi Devi, hosts a podcast on the Be Here Now Network, has trained as a hospice volunteer, and chairs Saving Wild Tigers, a charity that protects forest habitat in India.

courses.title: Learning The Hanuman Chalisa
courses.description: A ten-lesson audio course on Insight Timer that builds up the forty verses of the Hanuman Chalisa a few at a time, with help on the Awadhi sounds English speakers find hard and reflections on what each verse means.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Flow of Grace Immersion
courses.description: A self-paced course of six recorded sessions, over twelve hours in all, taught with Krishna Das. It covers the text, sound and meaning of the Hanuman Chalisa and Hanumat Stavan, with readings from the Sundarakand, plenty of chanting and questions from participants.

courses.title: Vedic Threads: Mantra through Vedic Chanting vs. Kirtan
courses.description: A recorded two-session class on Satsangam in which Nina and Vedic chanting teacher Shantala Sriramaiah compare exact, lineage-based Vedic recitation with the open, devotional style of kirtan. Access lasts thirty days from purchase.

courses.title: Ram Dass Legacy 2026: Open Your Heart in Paradise Maui Retreat
courses.description: A five-day retreat at the Napili Kai Beach Resort on Maui, held by the Love Serve Remember Foundation with Krishna Das and friends, including Nina. Days combine chanting, meditation, talks and time by the ocean.

courses.title: RADIATING 2027: The Light of the Compassionate Heart
courses.description: A New Year retreat at Menla in Phoenicia, New York, that opens with kirtan from Krishna Das, Nina and their band. Over five days there are further chanting sessions, yoga, qi gong and conversations before the year turns.

courses.title: The Heart of the Path: Wisdom & Wellbeing Intensive with Krishna Das & Nina Rao
courses.description: A week at Blue Spirit in Nosara, Costa Rica, given to chant in many forms: kirtan, long prayers to the Goddess, the Hanuman Chalisa and Vedic mantra. Krishna Das holds open question sessions and there is daily yoga for all levels.

free_resources.title: Nina Rao on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Nina's recordings of Indian devotional chants and mantras, including several versions of the Hanuman Chalisa, free to hear in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Hanuman Chalisa: words and translation
free_resources.description: The full Hanuman Chalisa in transliteration with an English rendering of each verse, plus a printable file, for anyone learning to chant it.

free_resources.title: Chant lyrics
free_resources.description: Nina's collection of words for the chants she leads, from Goddess prayers to names of Ram and Krishna, so you can sing along at home or at a kirtan.

flags: Works closely with Krishna Das (his business manager and co-teacher); three of the six offerings and two videos are shared with him. If Krishna Das is listed or planned, link rather than duplicate.
Most videos are live devotional chanting (kirtan, Hanuman Chalisa) rather than spoken teaching; kept as group chanting practice, but a reviewer may see them as music.
Retreats are run by other organisations (Love Serve Remember Foundation, Menla, Blue Spirit); prices are not shown on their pages, so 'Contact for pricing'.
Availability set to local_online with New York as base: she leads regular in-person events in New York City and teaches online, but has no studio of her own.
Dev dry run: the Maui retreat link (web.cvent.com Ram Dass Legacy 2026) is already on dev under another listing, so ingest will skip it; 5 offerings would be added.
left_out: Nada for Healing (Satsangam course with Dr Shubham): description names neurological healing and clinical use.
Traditional Vedic Chanting and Devotional Kirtan as Sound Medicine (Shift Network talk) and video 'The Sound Medicine of Sacred Vedic and Kirtan Chanting': 'medicine' framing, borderline.
Sacred Traditional Mantra & Chant Practices (Shift Network course 49914): page returned 403, price not verified.
Kirtan at Home with Nina Rao (Embodied Philosophy): included in a membership with no price shown.
The Goddess in Her Many Forms: no page of its own (general Living/Dying Project guest library).
Wisdom Rising and Cultivating Wise Hope: older recorded programmes, availability unclear.
Video 'Peace of Mind A Refuge From Trauma' and invitation to a Sound Healing Retreat at an Ayurveda Healing Center: condition or healing framing.
Concerts and album events (Bengaluru 5 Nov, SOUK release party 23 Nov) and the free New Year's Day 108 Hanuman Chalisas: performances or one-off dated events.
No books authored by her found on Amazon (she contributes to Sita's Gems, an audiobook course).
